campusLocations.notes: Equipped with 45 workstations, IoT testbeds, and server distribution rack.
Tiered auditorium seating for 120 students with ceiling projector and sound system.
Silent study zone with air conditioning units and individual power sockets.
Standard 60-seater lecture room with whiteboard and dual ceiling fans.
Common washroom facilities and plumbing supply manifolds.
Main food court dining hall, Wi-Fi hotspot access point AP-04.
High-density rack cabinets and embedded systems test benches.
Lathe, milling machines, and heavy mechanical equipment floor.

complaints.complaint_title: Exposed live wire sparking in Computer Lab 3
complaints.description: Near workstation 14, there is an exposed wire sparking when touched. This is extremely dangerous for students using the laboratory.
complaints.location: Technology Block C (CSE), 3rd Floor, Lab 304 (Workstation Bay)
complaints.emergency_notes: Priority 1 Hazard: Live electrical line isolated by facility supervisor.

complaints.complaint_title: Ceiling Projector color distortion and flickering
complaints.description: The overhead HDMI projector turns magenta and flickers continuously during lectures, making slides unreadable.
complaints.location: Main Academic Block, 1st Floor, Lecture Hall 101

complaints.complaint_title: AC Unit leaking water over study tables
complaints.description: Split air conditioner unit #2 is leaking condensated water directly onto student desks and carpet tiles.
complaints.location: Central Library, 2nd Floor, Reading Room & Study Bays

complaints.complaint_title: Broken bench armrests and wobbly chairs
complaints.description: Three desks in row 4 have loose armrests and wobbly frames that could collapse when sat on.

complaints.complaint_title: Hostel 4 washroom main tap pipe fracture
complaints.description: The main cold water pipe has a crack and is continuously flooding the 1st floor corridor.
complaints.location: Boys Hostel 4, 1st Floor, Wing A Restroom & Wash Corridor

complaints.complaint_title: Campus Wi-Fi access point dropping connection
complaints.description: SSID CampusNet-5G shows connected without internet every 5 minutes in the cafeteria area.
complaints.location: Student Center Cafeteria, Ground Floor, North Dining Wing

complaints.complaint_title: Dust and debris accumulated behind server racks
complaints.description: Routine cleaning required behind IoT lab server racks before semester practicals.
complaints.location: Innovation Hub, Basement 1, IoT Advanced Lab B1
